issues.detail: UID 1000 is not named in the container; Isabelle default temporary directory caused I/O errors.
issues.resolution: Set a project-specific ISABELLE_TMP_PREFIX in isolated user settings.

issues.detail: declare_prototype generated no dependency proof obligations, so by read_write_confined failed with No subgoals.
issues.resolution: Close the empty obligation with done; translation correspondence is still natively checked.

issues.detail: Two Isabelle sessions initially shared one theory directory.
issues.resolution: Separate foundation and target session directories.

issues.detail: Matching Exn accidentally specialized the contract combinator to an option exception type.
issues.resolution: Use an explicit polymorphic spec_monad type and existential normal Result postcondition.

issues.detail: An instrumented rerun repeatedly emitted AddressSanitizer:DEADLYSIGNAL and did not terminate. The affected container was killed; no functional counterexample was obtained.
issues.resolution: Use a non-PIE executable, disable only ASan's SIGSEGV handler, retain address/UB/leak instrumentation, and enforce a 30-second kill timeout. Revised check passed.
issues.root_cause: not conclusively established; runtime/layout interaction is suspected
